profile.name: Mohammad Hossein Yaghobi
profile.title: Backend & DevOps Software Engineer / Systems Architect
profile.bio: Architecting high-concurrency RESTful microservices, zero-copy network gateways, automated Kubernetes/Docker pipelines, and offline cryptography. Focused on deterministic execution, memory-constrained footprints (<10MB RSS), and 99.9% uptime SLA.

education.focus: Operating Systems, Distributed Networks, Compilers, and Algorithm Analysis

honors.title: Silver Medalist — National Innovation Award
honors.titlePersian: دارنده مدال نقره جایزه ملی نوآوری (علوم کامپیوتر)
honors.description: Awarded national silver medal for exceptional computational problem-solving, algorithmic efficiency, and software architecture innovation in national computing challenges.

highlights: Designed and built scalable RESTful APIs secured with JWT/OAuth2, supporting thousands of concurrent users in production.
Automated multi-stage deployment pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (GitLab CI & GitHub Actions), reducing release turnaround time by 40%.
Reduced API latency by 30% through multi-level Redis caching architectures and complex SQL/ORM query optimizations.
Configured centralized logging with ELK stack and infrastructure observability via Prometheus & Grafana to maintain a strict 99.9% uptime SLA.
Authored comprehensive OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and Postman collections to ensure seamless collaboration across engineering teams.

experience.company: Chabahar University of Maritime and Marine Sciences
highlights: Developed enterprise booking, course scheduling, and CRM workflows using Django REST Framework with role-based permission tiers.
Integrated secure payment gateways via asynchronous Webhook listeners and built a ticketing system; prevented race-condition double-booking using PostgreSQL transactional isolation.
Boosted database throughput by 25% through schema re-indexing, query optimization, and localized Redis caching layers.
Documented all API endpoints with Swagger OpenAPI and published onboarding guides for frontend development teams.
Conducted university coursework and international mentorship on Python programming, algorithm design, memory management, and object-oriented architecture.
Guided students through real-world automation scripts and backend web services.

projects.name: Oxiroute
projects.tagline: High-Throughput Production AI Gateway & LLM Router
projects.description: Ultra-fast, lightweight production AI gateway and LLM router built in pure Rust. Features zero-copy Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming via Axum and Tokio runtime, 3-tier resilience fallback cascades, SOCKS5 upstream proxy tunneling, token compaction, and an interactive Ratatui TUI dashboard. Engineered for sub-millisecond overhead and strict memory constraints (<10MB RSS).

projects.name: Khales
projects.description: Android personal finance application built with Jetpack Compose Material 3 and Room database. Parses incoming Iranian bank SMS notifications 100% offline with zero cloud telemetry using deterministic regex matching. Backed by SQLCipher AES-256 zero-knowledge on-device encryption.

projects.name: Autonomous AI Trading Platform
projects.tagline: Pure Python ReAct Agent Core with Asynchronous Telemetry
projects.description: Algorithmic trading engine with pure Python ReAct reasoning core, 3-tier memory management (Short-term, Episodic, Playbooks), FastAPI asynchronous orderbook streaming, and TradingView Lightweight Charts with AI Canvas overlays.

projects.name: Golestan Automation & VahedYar
projects.description: Lightweight, pure-HTTP reverse-engineered client for the nationwide university portal (Golestan). Bypasses legacy ASP/ActiveX bottlenecks with an async scraping pipeline, SQLite full-text search index (FTS5), Typer CLI, and a production web SPA on Vercel.

projects.name: Mavis Desktop HUD

projects.description: Wayland Linux floating notch & dynamic island desktop assistant built with Tauri 2.0, Rust, and React. Integrates low-latency audio visualization and hardware hotkey dispatching.
